The '''Xamsters''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]].<ref name="AEYNTK" /> The species had exceptional [[brain]]s capable of thinking quickly<ref name="EV">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and processing sensory data at high speed.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> The [[Podracer (profession)|podracer]] [[Neva Kee]] was a Xamster.<ref name="AEYNTK" />
